news.title: Flames beat Kraken 6-2 behind career-best 4 points from Matt Coronato

news.description: — Matt Coronato had a career-high four points with a goal and three assists to lead the Calgary Flames over the Seattle Kraken 6-2 on Friday night.

news.title: Anton Lundell scores 3 goals, Seth Jones caps record month and Panthers beat reeling Jets 5-2
news.ruTitle: Антон Ланделл забил 3 гола, Сет Джонс провел рекордный месяц, а «Пантеры» обыграли «Джетс» со счетом 5–2.
news.description: — Anton Lundell had a hat trick, Seth Jones capped a record-setting month with a goal and two assists, and the Florida Panthers topped the reeling Winnipeg Jets 5-2 on Friday night for their sixth win in eight games.

news.title: Ottawa Senators F Hayden Hodgson suspended by NHL's Department of Player Safety

news.description: On Friday, Ottawa Senators forward Hayden Hodgson was suspended two games by the NHL's Department of Player Safety for charging and boarding Los Angeles Kings defenseman Brandt Clarke earlier in the week.

news.title: Hellebuyck stops 19 shots in 5-2 victory over Golden Knights, wins 2nd straight since joining Devils
news.ruTitle: Хеллебайк отразил 19 бросков в победе над "Голден Найтс" со счетом 5:2 и одержал вторую победу подряд с момента перехода в "Девилз".
news.description: — Connor Hellebuyck stopped 19 shots, Arseny Gritsyuk and Jack Hughes each scored twice and the New Jersey Devils beat the Vegas Golden Knights 5-2 on Friday.
